name: ice_bong
prompt: A single game icon on a fully transparent background, nothing else: a water bong CARVED FROM CLEAR GLACIER ICE, seen exactly from the FRONT, perfectly upright and left-right symmetrical, facing straight at the viewer. Stocky, compact proportions so it fills the picture: a wide round flask base holding icy turquoise water with a few bubbles, a short thick straight neck with an ice-catcher pinch and two ice cubes resting on it, a fat rounded rim at the top with a small cap of snow and a few short icicles. Its bowl sits low on the FRONT of the flask, pointing toward the viewer on a short stub of a stem: a round ice bowl packed with green herb with a small glowing orange ember on top and one thin wisp of smoke. More REALISTIC than a flat cartoon: translucent, glassy ice you can see into - soft refraction and inner glow, frosted patches, fine cracks, bright specular highlights on the curves, cool blue shading that turns paler toward the edges, the water line visible through the ice - a polished semi-realistic slot-game icon. A clean dark navy outline around the whole silhouette so it sits beside cartoon symbols. No hands, no characters, no table, no shadow on the ground, no text. Everything else fully transparent.

name: menu_chance
prompt:
Wide artwork for a slot-game menu card called HIGHER CHANCE. The character is EXACTLY the yeti of the first reference picture, drawn in the same flat cartoon style, line weight and colours: a big friendly grey-blue yeti with shaggy white fur and a white beard, a blue nose, sleepy happy eyes and a wide grin, an orange knit beanie with a white pom-pom, purple ski goggles pushed up on the beanie, a lime-green puffer jacket open over his white furry belly, purple cargo snow pants, chunky orange snowboard boots, and his yellow snowboard with purple flames. He is the only character: no people, no other animals. Scene: the yeti sits alone on a red chairlift chair riding up toward the snowy mountain top of the second reference picture, leaning forward with wide excited eyes and crossed fingers, his snowboard strapped to one foot dangling below; around him in the air float three big shiny round game tokens - gold tokens with a green cannabis leaf over a snowy peak - sparkling, with little upward arrows of light; bright blue sky, the sea of snowy peaks far below. The yeti and the tokens are in the RIGHT two thirds of the picture; the left third is calm sky and far peaks (text is laid over it later). Full-bleed, no border. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs with writing anywhere in the picture.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
